## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Huáyán jīng zhǐ guī* in 1 fascicle is [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng's compact synopsis of the doctrinal aims (*zhǐ guī* 旨歸 — "to where the aims point") of the *[Avataṃsaka jīng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0001)*. The work is structured around 10 essential aims, which Fǎzàng treats serially: *yī* (one), *èr* (two), etc. — the *Avataṃsaka*'s characteristic ten-fold numerical organisation. Each aim is treated compactly with citations from the parent sūtra and brief doctrinal exposition.

**Abstract**

The work is conventionally datable to [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng's mature Cháng'ān period, c. 670 – 712 CE; the bracket adopted here reflects this window. The *Zhǐ guī* belongs to the genre of *summa* writings — alongside the *[Wén yì gāngmù 文義綱目](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0005)* (T1734) and the much fuller *[Tànxuán jì](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0008)* (T1733) — by which Fǎzàng made the substance of his major commentaries accessible to students at multiple levels of doctrinal sophistication. The 10-aim format anticipates the 42-topic *[Lüè cè](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0015)* of [澄觀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%BE%84%E8%A7%80) Chéngguān (T1737, also a 1-fascicle compact synopsis).

The Taishō text (T1871) is established on the standard apparatus.
